sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《99%隐形》。我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: The line to enter Barcelona's most famous cathedral often stretches around the block.
sentences.zh: 进入巴塞罗那最著名的这座大教堂的队伍，常常排得拐了好几个弯。

sentences.en: La Sagrada Familia, designed by Antony Gaudí, draws so many people to see it that the neighborhood
sentences.zh: 由安东尼·高迪设计的圣家族大教堂吸引了无数人前来参观，以至于周边街区

sentences.en: is congested with tour buses and taxis and scooters.
sentences.zh: 挤满了旅游大巴、出租车和踏板摩托车。

sentences.en: the church in 2016, and another 7 million came just to stare at the outside of this strange
sentences.zh: 在2016年进入教堂内部参观，另有700万人只是为了驻足观赏这座造型奇特的

sentences.en: If you travel around Spain, you'll see a lot of old Gothic churches.
sentences.zh: 如果你在西班牙各地旅行，会看到许多古老的哥特式教堂。

sentences.en: Producer Katie Mingle was in Spain earlier this year.
sentences.zh: 制作人凯蒂·明格今年早些时候去了西班牙。

sentences.en: First, it doesn't look like a Gothic cathedral.
sentences.zh: 首先，它看起来一点也不像哥特式教堂。

sentences.en: it was built out of bones, or sand, or like it just twirled out of the sea, like a fractal.
sentences.zh: 像是用骨头或沙子建造的，或者就像是从海中凭空旋转而出的分形结构。
它看起来有一种天然的有机感。

sentences.en: But there's another thing that sets it apart from your average old Gothic cathedral.
sentences.zh: 但还有另一个特点让它区别于普通的古老哥特式教堂。

sentences.en: Gaudí wasn't able to build very much of it before he died in 1926.
sentences.zh: 在1926年去世之前，高迪并没有能建造完成多少部分。

sentences.en: has been built in the last 40 years, and it still isn't finished.
sentences.zh: 都是在过去40年里建造的，而且至今尚未完工。

sentences.en: Which means that architects have had to figure out, and still are figuring out, how Gaudí
sentences.zh: 这意味着建筑师们过去不得不、现在也依然在摸索，究竟高迪

sentences.en: wanted the church to be built.
sentences.zh: 希望这座教堂该如何建造。

sentences.en: We are all together in a room.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都在一个房间里。

sentences.en: The most important part of the building
sentences.zh: 这是我们正在建造的建筑中

sentences.en: That's Jerónimo Bouchardayo, one of the current architects of the building.
sentences.zh: 那是赫罗尼莫·布沙尔达约，该建筑现任建筑师之一。

sentences.en: clues to understanding how to move forward on the construction of La Sagrada Familia are
sentences.zh: 理解如何推进圣家族大教堂建设的关键线索

sentences.en: kept in the room we're standing in right now, in the basement of the church.
sentences.zh: 就存放在我们此刻所在的这个房间里，也就是教堂的地下室。

sentences.en: So since this is radio, can you describe what's in this room?
sentences.zh: 既然这是一档广播节目，你能描述一下这个房间里有什么吗？

sentences.en: There are a lot of shelves with fragments, little pieces of plaster, big, small.
sentences.zh: 这里有许多架子，上面摆满了各种碎片，有大大小小的石膏碎块。

sentences.en: Before he died, Gaudí left elaborate plaster models detailing his plans for finishing the
sentences.zh: 在高迪去世前，他留下了精心制作的石膏模型，详细记录了他完成

sentences.en: But about 80 years ago, they were all basically destroyed.
sentences.zh: 但在大约80年前，它们基本上全被毁了。

sentences.en: It doesn't look like just from this and those little pieces that that would be enough to
sentences.zh: 光凭这些和那些小碎块，似乎还不足以

sentences.en: Yeah, I understand that it's difficult to know what we have to do if the main architect is not
sentences.zh: 对，我理解，如果主建筑师不在了，
要想知道我们该做些什么确实很困难。

sentences.en: What we try to do is to understand how he thought.
sentences.zh: 我们努力去做的，是去理解他的思维方式。

sentences.en: It definitely hasn't been easy for the new architects to recreate and understand the vision of Antony
sentences.zh: 对于新建筑师们来说，要重现并理解安东尼·高迪的宏伟愿景，绝对不是一件容易的事。

sentences.en: And there are people who think they shouldn't even have tried, that the building should have
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至认为他们根本不该尝试，这座建筑
本该在高迪去世后就停止建造。

sentences.en: The building is currently the longest running
sentences.zh: 这座建筑目前是世界上

sentences.en: And the architects are still trying to understand the
sentences.zh: 而建筑师们仍在试图理解

sentences.en: Antony Gaudí grew up in a little town called Reus, which, like Barcelona, was part of a region of Spain
sentences.zh: 安东尼·高迪在一个名叫雷乌斯的小镇长大，和巴塞罗那一样，那里也是西班牙一个被称为
加泰罗尼亚的地区的一部分。

sentences.en: And although he's become one of Spain's most famous architects, Gaudí would never
sentences.zh: 尽管他后来成为了西班牙最著名的建筑师之一，但高迪生前
从未认为自己是西班牙人。

sentences.en: He was Catalonian through and through.
sentences.zh: 他骨子里是个彻头彻尾的加泰罗尼亚人。

sentences.en: Catalonia has been in the news recently because of its movement for independence from Spain.
sentences.zh: 加泰罗尼亚最近因为争取脱离西班牙独立的运动而频频登上新闻。

sentences.en: But in many ways, this movement isn't new.
sentences.zh: 但在很多方面，这场运动并不是新鲜事。

sentences.en: Catalonians have struggled against the rule
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来，加泰罗尼亚人一直在抗争

sentences.en: Catalonia, it has a separate language, Catalan.
sentences.zh: 加泰罗尼亚有它自己的语言——加泰罗尼亚语。

sentences.en: It has always felt very separate.
sentences.zh: 它一直给人一种非常独立的感觉。
那是赫伊斯·范·汉斯贝亨。

sentences.en: My name is Geis van Hensbergen.
sentences.zh: 我叫赫伊斯·范·汉斯贝亨。

sentences.en: I'm the biographer of Antony Gaudí.
sentences.zh: 我是安东尼·高迪的传记作家。

sentences.en: Van Hensbergen says that as a child growing up in Catalonia, Gaudí spent a lot of time outside
sentences.zh: 范·汉斯贝亨说，高迪在加泰罗尼亚度过的童年时期，把大量时间花在户外，

sentences.en: and was completely enthralled with the natural world around him.
sentences.zh: 并且完全被身边的自然世界所吸引。

sentences.en: What he would later call the great book of nature.
sentences.zh: 他后来称之为“大自然这部伟大的书”。

sentences.en: A lot of kids are curious about nature, but for Antony Gaudí, it was different.
sentences.zh: 许多孩子都对自然充满好奇，但对安东尼·高迪来说，情况有所不同。
这成了一种极致的痴迷。

sentences.en: He seemed to absorb essential lessons from the patterns and shapes he saw in nature.
sentences.zh: 他似乎从自然界中看到的图案和形状中汲取了至关重要的法则。

sentences.en: Just looking at the way the insects were walking and flowers grew, the way that a tree grows
sentences.zh: 只需观察昆虫行走的方式、花朵的盛开，以及树木生长和

sentences.en: and where it throws out branches.
A dried-out snake skeleton, a honeycomb, these were nature's perfect constructions.
sentences.zh: 干枯的蛇骨、蜂巢，这些都是大自然完美的结构。

sentences.en: And for Gaudí, a deeply religious Catholic, God was the master architect of these flawless
sentences.zh: 对于信仰深厚的天主教徒高迪来说，上帝便是这些完美有机结构的

sentences.en: Eventually, Gaudí left his small town in the countryside and moved to Barcelona for university and
sentences.zh: 最终，高迪离开了乡村小镇，搬到巴塞罗那上大学，
随后又进入建筑学校深造。

sentences.en: When he graduated in 1878, the director of the school said,
sentences.zh: 他在1878年毕业时，学校的院长曾说：

sentences.en: We are here today either in the presence of a genius or a madman.
sentences.zh: 我们今天面对的，要么是一位天才，要么是一个疯子。

sentences.en: Gaudí began his career at a difficult moment in Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 高迪的职业生涯始于巴塞罗那一个艰难的时期。

sentences.en: The Industrial Revolution had brought thousands of workers from the countryside into the city
sentences.zh: 工业革命将成千上万的乡村工人吸引到城市里，

sentences.en: They were toiling in terrible conditions, packed into filthy tenements, drinking dirty water.
sentences.zh: 他们在恶劣的条件下劳作，挤在肮脏的廉租房里，饮用受污染的水。

sentences.en: Diseases like yellow fever and cholera were rampant.
sentences.zh: 黄热病和霍乱等疾病肆虐。

sentences.en: In the midst of all of this suffering, a bookseller named Josep Bocabella began selling a fundamentalist
sentences.zh: 在重重苦难之中，一个名叫何塞普·博卡贝拉的书商开始出售原教旨主义的

sentences.en: newspaper, the kind that reminded everyone that their misery was punishment for their sins.
sentences.zh: 报纸，这种报纸不断提醒大家，他们的苦难是对他们罪孽的惩罚。
出人意料的是，这居然很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Pretty soon, Bocabella was making quite a lot of money from his Catholic guilt-themed newspaper.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，博卡贝拉靠着他那份打着天主教负罪感旗号的报纸赚了不少钱。

sentences.en: Which he squirreled away, kept apparently hidden under the tiles of his bookshop.
sentences.zh: 他把这些钱存了起来，显然藏在了他书店的地砖下面。

sentences.en: With the piles of money he was accumulating, Bocabella decided to build a church.
sentences.zh: 凭借积攒如山的财富，博卡贝拉决定建造一座教堂。

sentences.en: One meant to inspire the common folk to lead a religious life.
sentences.zh: 一座旨在激励普通民众过上宗教生活的教堂。

sentences.en: The church would be dedicated to Mary, Joseph, and Jesus.
sentences.zh: 这座教堂将供奉玛丽、约瑟夫和耶稣。

sentences.en: The first architect that Bocabella hired quit after a year, and he went looking for a new one.
sentences.zh: 博卡贝拉雇用的第一位建筑师在一年后辞职了，于是他开始寻找新人。

sentences.en: Legend goes, Bocabella had a dream one night.
sentences.zh: 传说博卡贝拉有一天晚上做了一个梦。

sentences.en: That a ginger-haired, blue-eyed man would come to the rescue.
sentences.zh: 梦见一个红发蓝眼的男子会来拯救他。

sentences.en: The very next day, Bocabella saw the person from his dream in real life, drawing in the studio of another architect he knew.
sentences.zh: 就在第二天，博卡贝拉在现实生活中见到了他梦中的那个人，当时他正在他认识的另一位建筑师的工作室里画画。

sentences.en: And he says, well, you're the man.
sentences.zh: 于是他说，噢，你就是那个人。

sentences.en: The man he had seen was Antony Gaudí.
sentences.zh: 他见到的人正是安东尼·高迪。

sentences.en: And immediately, Bocabella hired him to be the architect of his church.
sentences.zh: 博卡贝拉立刻聘请他担任自己教堂的建筑师。

sentences.en: The greatest job in Spain at that time was given to this completely, almost completely unknown 29-year-old who'd done very little work.
sentences.zh: 当时西班牙最伟大的工作交给了这位几乎完全默默无闻、年仅29岁且作品寥寥的年轻人。

sentences.en: The basic floor plan for La Sagrada Familia had already been laid out by the former architect, and Gaudí would stick with it.
sentences.zh: 圣家族大教堂的基本平面图已经由前任建筑师规划好了，高迪决定沿用它。

sentences.en: The church would be built in the neo-Gothic style, which was popular at the time in Europe.
sentences.zh: 这座教堂将采用当时在欧洲流行的哥特复兴式风格。

sentences.en: But Gaudí also wanted the church to be something completely unique, inspired by nature and by God.
sentences.zh: 但高迪还希望教堂能成为独一无二的事物，从自然和上帝那里汲取灵感。

sentences.en: What Gaudí wanted was a building which would actually have the kind of harmonies of the celestial spheres,
sentences.zh: 高迪想要的是一座真正拥有天球和谐之美的建筑，

sentences.en: the idea of that everything has a harmony in nature, and that if you got that right in your building, the building itself would spiritualize you.
sentences.zh: 这种理念认为世间万物在自然中皆有其和谐韵律，如果你在建筑中把握好了这一点，建筑本身就能净化你的精神。

sentences.en: That said, Gaudí would never allow the building to outshine God's creations.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，高迪绝不允许这座建筑的光芒盖过上帝的造物。

sentences.en: So he set a limit on how tall the church would ever get.
sentences.zh: 因此，他为教堂的高度设定了上限。

sentences.en: He felt that he didn't want to be taller than God's handiwork, and God's handiwork were, of course, the mountains on either side.
sentences.zh: 他觉得这座建筑不应该比上帝的杰作更高，而上帝的杰作自然就是两侧的山峰。

sentences.en: La Sagrada Familia would be one meter, or about three feet, shorter than Mount Monjuic in Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 圣家族大教堂将比巴塞罗那的蒙特惠奇山矮一米，大约三英尺。

sentences.en: You know, just to keep it humble.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这是为了保持谦逊。

sentences.en: In 1883, when Gaudí started work on La Sagrada Familia, his first matter of business was to finish the crypt,
sentences.zh: 1883年，当高迪开始着手建造圣家族大教堂时，他的首要任务是完成地下室的建设，

sentences.en: which had been started by the previous architect.
sentences.zh: 该地下室由前任建筑师开工建造。

sentences.en: The crypt is essentially a small church under the bigger church, and a place where important people are buried.
sentences.zh: 地下室本质上是大教堂下方的一座小教堂，也是安葬重要人物的地方。

sentences.en: In fact, Josep Bocabella was buried there when he died in 1892.
sentences.zh: 事实上，何塞普·博卡贝拉在1892年去世后就被安葬在那里。

sentences.en: Nine years after he hired Gaudí.
sentences.zh: 就在他雇佣高迪的九年后。

sentences.en: The Sagrada Familia crypt was big enough to hold services in,
sentences.zh: 圣家族大教堂的地下室大到足以举行礼拜仪式，

sentences.en: and this kept everyone happy while Gaudí took his time designing the rest of the building.
sentences.zh: 这让所有人都很满意，而高迪则可以从容不迫地设计建筑的其余部分。

sentences.en: When Bocabella died, management of the construction passed through various hands.
sentences.zh: 博卡贝拉去世后，建设的管理权几经易手。

sentences.en: But for Gaudí, there was only one client that really mattered.
sentences.zh: 但对高迪而言，真正重要的客户只有一个。

sentences.en: God is the client, and God is never in a hurry.
sentences.zh: 上帝才是客户，而上帝从不急躁。

sentences.en: After the crypt was finished, Gaudí began to build the first big wall of the building,
sentences.zh: 地下室完工后，高迪开始建造建筑的第一面大墙，

sentences.en: He would work on it for the rest of his life, but it was important to him that this facade get done first, because...
sentences.zh: 他在余生中一直致力于此，但对它而言，首先建好这个立面至关重要，因为……

sentences.en: It would be the Bible written in stone, which people, if they couldn't even read or write,
sentences.zh: 这将是一部用石头写就的圣经，人们即便不识字，

sentences.en: they could look at the building and be taught about the values of the Catholic faith.
sentences.zh: 也能通过观察这座建筑来了解天主教信仰的价值。

sentences.en: Gaudí was a sculptor as much as an architect, and the wall would be full of stone sculptures depicting biblical scenes.
sentences.zh: 高迪不仅是一位建筑师，还是一位雕塑家，这面墙上将布满描绘圣经场景的石雕。

sentences.en: The baptism of Christ, Christ in the workshop with his father, the flight to Egypt, with a life-sized donkey.
sentences.zh: 基督受洗、基督与父亲在作坊中、逃往埃及，其中还包含一头真人大小的驴。

sentences.en: The stone sculpture of a donkey in that seam was actually cast in plaster from a real live donkey.
sentences.zh: 那一幕中的驴的石雕实际上是用一头真正的活驴通过石膏翻模制作的。

sentences.en: It had to be a particular donkey.
sentences.zh: 那必须是一头特定的驴。

sentences.en: He wanted a donkey that looked as if it had been through the desert for 40 days.
sentences.zh: 他想要一头看起来就像是在沙漠里历经40天苦难的驴。

sentences.en: One of Gaudí's workers actually wandered the streets until he found the perfect starving donkey,
sentences.zh: 高迪的一名工人实际上在街头四处寻找，直到找到了一头完美的饥饿的驴，

sentences.en: which he excitedly handed over to Gaudí.
sentences.zh: 然后兴奋地把它交给了高迪。

sentences.en: He took the donkey and he put the donkey up in a harness.
sentences.zh: 他牵过这头驴，给它套上挽具。
他给它用了氯仿实施麻醉。

sentences.en: And then he cast the whole live donkey.
sentences.zh: 然后对整头活驴进行了翻模。

sentences.en: Antony Gaudí also tried making plaster molds from live human beings.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·高迪还尝试过用活人制作石膏模具。

sentences.en: He actually tried to do it with one of his workers, but he almost killed him and decided that maybe that wasn't the best way forward.
sentences.zh: 他确实在一个工人身上尝试过，但差点把对方害死，于是觉得这或许不是最好的方法。

sentences.en: This all took an incredibly long time, but eventually the wall started to tell a story in stone.
sentences.zh: 这一切花费了极其漫长的时间，但最终这面墙开始用石头讲述一个故事。

sentences.en: And it featured hundreds of celestial and earthly creatures.
sentences.zh: 并且它的特色是融入了数百种天上和地上的生物。

sentences.en: Little snails crawling all over it and tortoises.
sentences.zh: 到处爬行的小蜗牛和陆龟。

sentences.en: The facade became crowded and cluttered and teeming with life.
sentences.zh: 这座立面变得拥挤繁复，充满了生机。

sentences.en: Kind of almost swampish kind of quality of the stone, oozing, kind of organic shaping of the building.
sentences.zh: 这种石材带着一种近乎沼泽般的质感，不断渗出液体，建筑的造型也带有某种有机的形态。

sentences.en: It was very unusual, very extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 这非常罕见，非常非同寻常。

sentences.en: Antony Gaudí was slowly building a Catholic church.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·高迪当时正在慢慢建造一座天主教堂。

sentences.en: But not everyone was convinced that Catholicism had anything of value to offer the average working citizen.
sentences.zh: 但并不是所有人都相信天主教能为普通的工薪阶层带来任何价值。

sentences.en: Leftists saw the church as getting rich from the tithes of the poor.
sentences.zh: 左翼人士认为教会靠着穷人的十一税发财。

sentences.en: They saw them as being wealthy, as being parasitic, as living off them.
sentences.zh: 在他们眼里，教会富有、寄生且靠着他们过活。

sentences.en: Communism, socialism, and anarchism were taking hold in other parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 共产主义、社会主义和无政府主义正在世界其他地方兴起。

sentences.en: And in Spain, these leftist parties thought they could offer the struggling worker a better life.
sentences.zh: 而在西班牙，这些左翼政党认为他们能为挣扎中的工人提供更好的生活。

sentences.en: Conflict between leftists and the state and leftists and the church were a constant.
sentences.zh: 左翼与国家之间以及左翼与教会之间的冲突不断。

sentences.en: For the last decade of the 19th century, there's probably on average something like two bombs every week in the center of the city.
sentences.zh: 在19世纪的最后十年里，市中心平均差不多每星期就会发生两起炸弹袭击。

sentences.en: Throughout the years, Gaudí worked on other architecture projects in Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 多年来，高迪在巴塞罗那还参与了其他建筑项目。

sentences.en: His work is peppered all over the city.
sentences.zh: 他的作品散布在整个城市的各处。

sentences.en: In palaces, pavilions, and extravagant homes, his sinuous and skeletal architecture was unmistakable.
sentences.zh: 在宫殿、亭阁和奢华的住宅中，他那蜿蜒曲折且充满骨骼感的建筑风格清晰可辨。

sentences.en: Everyone in Barcelona knew his style.
sentences.zh: 巴塞罗那的每个人都知道他的风格。

sentences.en: But La Sagrada Familia is the project that consumed him.
sentences.zh: 但《圣家堂》才是那个让他倾注了全部心血的项目。

sentences.en: He realized, of course, that he could never finish it and would never see it finished in his lifetime.
sentences.zh: 当然，他意识到自己永远无法完成它，也永远无法在有生之年看到它完工。

sentences.en: By 1926, 73-year-old Antony Gaudí had never married and was living alone.
sentences.zh: 到1926年，73岁的安东尼·高迪终身未婚，独居生活。

sentences.en: He spent a lot of nights sleeping in his studio at La Sagrada Familia, too obsessed with his work to care about his appearance.
sentences.zh: 他经常晚上睡在圣家堂的工作室里，对工作过于着迷，根本不在乎自己的外表。

sentences.en: He was looking a bit like a tramp, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他看起来有点像个流浪汉。

sentences.en: His trousers were held up with safety pins and a bit of string.
sentences.zh: 他的裤子是用安全别针和一小段绳子提起来的。

sentences.en: On June 7th of 1926, Gaudí is leaving work.
sentences.zh: 1926年6月7日，高迪正离开工作场所。

sentences.en: And as he crosses the railroad tracks...
He forgets to look and the tram runs him over.
sentences.zh: 他忘记查看路况，电车撞倒了他。

sentences.en: Antony Gaudí was left nearly dead on the railroad tracks.
sentences.zh: 安东尼·高迪倒在铁轨上，生命垂危。

sentences.en: When his body was found, he was taken to the hospital, where he died three days later.
sentences.zh: 当人们发现他的身体时，他被送往医院，并在三天后去世。

sentences.en: Gaudí was buried in the crypt under La Sagrada Familia.
sentences.zh: 高迪被安葬在圣家堂下方的地下室里。

sentences.en: His last years had been consumed with building the church.
sentences.zh: 他的最后几年全耗费在建造这座教堂上了。

sentences.en: But Barcelona had not forgotten Gaudí.
sentences.zh: 但巴塞罗那并没有忘记高迪。

sentences.en: Throngs of people came out to mourn.
sentences.zh: 成群结队的人们走上街头悼念。

sentences.en: It was guessed that almost a quarter of the population of Catalonia turned up in procession.
sentences.zh: 据估计，加泰罗尼亚近四分之一的人口都参加了送葬游行。

sentences.en: Hundreds of thousands of people were there.
When Gaudí died, he left behind a largely unfinished church.
sentences.zh: 高迪去世时，留下了一座大面积未完成的教堂。

sentences.en: What stood was a massive wall, the nativity facade, one tower, and the crypt.
sentences.zh: 当时矗立着的是一堵巨大的墙、诞生立面、一座高塔以及地下室。

sentences.en: His colleagues and apprentices would have a lot to do to bring his full vision into being.
sentences.zh: 他的同事和学徒们还有很多工作要做，才能将他的宏伟构想变为现实。

sentences.en: But Gaudí had anticipated that other architects would finish his work.
sentences.zh: 但高迪早就预料到会有其他建筑师来完成他的作品。

sentences.en: And he left behind detailed drawings and models outlining exactly how he wanted his magnum opus to be built.
sentences.zh: 他留下了详细的图纸和模型，确切地勾勒出他希望如何建造他的巅峰之作。

sentences.en: For ten years, work on La Sagrada Familia continued very slowly.
sentences.zh: 在长达十年的时间里，圣家堂的建设进展非常缓慢。

sentences.en: Much of Gaudí's former team stayed on, even though they could have gone and started their own projects.
sentences.zh: 高迪的大多数前团队成员都留了下来，尽管他们完全可以离开去开展自己的项目。

sentences.en: There was still work to be done.
The youth of Spain, from the north, east, south, and west, go forth to spill the life's blood of their brother Spaniard.
sentences.zh: 来自西班牙北部、东部、南部和西部的青年们出征了，去流淌同胞兄弟的鲜血。

sentences.en: The decades-old conflict between leftists and the state had finally come to a head.
sentences.zh: 左翼与国家之间持续了数十年的冲突终于达到了白热化。

sentences.en: The Republicans, who were an alliance of various leftist parties, fought against the Nationalists,
sentences.zh: 由各左翼政党联盟组成的共和派，与国民军展开了战斗，

sentences.en: which was an alliance of fascists and other conservatives, led by General Francisco Franco.
sentences.zh: 国民军是由法西斯分子和其他保守派组成的联盟，由弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥将军领导。

sentences.en: The Nationalists also had the support of most of Spain's Catholic clergy.
sentences.zh: 国民军还得到了西班牙大部分天主教神职人员的支持。

sentences.en: On the 18th of July, two days after the start of the Spanish Civil War,
sentences.zh: 7月18日，即西班牙内战爆发两天后，

sentences.en: a group of young anarchists break into the studios of Gaudí.
sentences.zh: 一群年轻的无政府主义者闯入了高迪的工作室。
用锤子把所有东西都砸个稀烂。

sentences.en: All the models, everything is smashed up into tiny little bits.
sentences.zh: 所有的模型，所有的东西都被砸成了细碎的小块。

sentences.en: When they're done smashing, they light the place of blaze.
sentences.zh: 他们砸完之后，便放火烧了那个地方。

sentences.en: Everything burns, including the architectural drawings.
sentences.zh: 一切都被烧毁了，包括建筑图纸。

sentences.en: And in fact, the following day, try to come back and bomb the nativity facade,
sentences.zh: 事实上，第二天他们还试图回来炸毁诞生立面，

sentences.en: which is the only work standing there of Gaudí's, which miraculously they failed to do.
sentences.zh: 那是高迪留在那里唯一的作品，奇迹般的是，他们没有炸成功。

sentences.en: Catholicism was under attack during the war.
sentences.zh: 战争期间，天主教受到了攻击。

sentences.en: And by the end of it, 40 churches in Barcelona had been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 到战争结束时，巴塞罗那已有40座教堂被毁。

sentences.en: And 12 people associated with the Sagrada Familia project,
sentences.zh: 与圣家堂项目相关的12人，

sentences.en: including some of its managing patrons and clergy, had been killed.
sentences.zh: 包括一些管理赞助人和神职人员在内，都被杀害了。

sentences.en: The leftists lost, the fascists won, and General Francisco Franco took control of Spain.
sentences.zh: 左翼失败了，法西斯胜利了，弗朗西斯科·佛朗哥将军控制了西班牙。

sentences.en: When it was all over, a few workers returned to Gaudí's studio to salvage what they could.
sentences.zh: 这一切结束后，几名工人回到高迪的工作室，试图抢救能救的东西。

sentences.en: They very carefully picked up in boxes little sections and fragments of the models.
sentences.zh: 他们非常小心地把模型的小部分和碎片收集到箱子里。

sentences.en: And like archaeologists do today, they started piecing them together.
sentences.zh: 就像今天的考古学家一样，他们开始把它们拼凑起来。

sentences.en: For the next couple of decades, the remaining architects and other workers
sentences.zh: 在随后的几十年里，剩下的建筑师和其他工人

sentences.en: tried to figure out how to move forward on the construction without Gaudí's plans.
sentences.zh: 试图在没有高迪图纸的情况下，弄清楚如何推进施工。

sentences.en: But outside the church, there was opposition to moving forward at all.
sentences.zh: 但在教堂外部，反对继续建设的声音一直存在。

sentences.en: In the 1960s, an impressive group of intellectuals and architects,
sentences.zh: 20世纪60年代，一群颇具影响力的知识分子和建筑师，

sentences.en: including Le Garbusier and Alvar Aalto,
sentences.zh: 包括勒·柯布西耶和阿尔瓦·阿尔托，

sentences.en: wrote an open letter opposing the continuation of La Sagrada Familia.
sentences.zh: 联名发表了一封公开信，反对继续修建圣家堂。

sentences.en: Gaudí wasn't only an architect, they argued.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，高迪不仅仅是一位建筑师。

sentences.en: And he shouldn't attempt to finish a work of art without the artiSt.
sentences.zh: 人们不应该在没有这位艺术家的前提下去试图完成一件艺术品。

sentences.en: They felt that this was a total waste of time.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这完全是浪费时间。

sentences.en: They should have left just the original nativity facade,
sentences.zh: 他们本应只留下最初的诞生立面，

sentences.en: almost like a Gothic ruin, there as a homage to Gaudí,
sentences.zh: 几乎就像哥特式废墟一样，立在那里作为对高迪的致敬，

sentences.en: and that Gaudí wasn't being well served.
sentences.zh: 而现在这样并没有真正善待高迪。

sentences.en: But the patrons of the project would have none of it.
sentences.zh: 但该项目的赞助人根本听不进去。

sentences.en: The building was never supposed to be an homage to Gaudí, they argued.
sentences.zh: 他们辩称，这座建筑从来都不是为了向高迪致敬而建的。

sentences.en: It was always about something bigger.
sentences.zh: 它一直都关乎更宏大的事物。

sentences.en: That said, they would try to honor Gaudí's original vision as faithfully as possible.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，他们还是会尽可能忠实地遵循高迪最初的构想。

sentences.en: The models and drawings had been the roadmap for how to move forward on the construction,
sentences.zh: 模型和图纸曾是推进施工的路线图，

sentences.en: and they were burned and smashed to pieces.
sentences.zh: 而它们却被焚烧并砸成了碎片。

sentences.en: And this wasn't just any cathedral.
sentences.zh: 而且这不仅仅是任何一座大教堂。

sentences.en: All these years, Gaudí had been designing something so unique,
sentences.zh: 这么多年来，高迪设计的东西如此独特，

sentences.en: so complex, and so completely new,
that it would take his successors years to fully get a handle on it.
sentences.zh: 以至于他的继任者们需要花上好几年才能完全掌握它。

sentences.en: By the 1970s, another huge facade was going up.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪70年代，另一座宏伟的立面正在拔地而起。

sentences.en: But the church still had no interior and no roof.
sentences.zh: 但这座教堂仍然没有内部结构，也没有屋顶。

sentences.en: It was just walls and towers, a construction site open to the rain.
sentences.zh: 它只有墙壁和高塔，是一个向雨水开放的工地。

sentences.en: Well, I first went to Barcelona in 1977, when I was 20.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我第一次去巴塞罗那是在1977年，当时我20岁。
说话的是建筑师马克·伯里。

sentences.en: Mark had actually been told in architecture school that Gaudí was not worth studying
sentences.zh: 马克在建筑学校里其实被告知不值得去研究高迪，

sentences.en: because his approach was too esoteric.
sentences.zh: 因为他的方法过于深奥。

sentences.en: That he was too extraordinary and that there was no school,
sentences.zh: 说他太非同寻常了，根本没有什么学派可言，

sentences.en: meaning that there was, you know, nothing to see, move along.
sentences.zh: 意思是说，你知道的，没什么好看的，请继续走吧。

sentences.en: This just got Burry more curious.
sentences.zh: 这反而激起了伯里更大的好奇心。

sentences.en: So he went to have a look at the Sagrada Familia himself.
sentences.zh: 于是他亲自去参观了圣家堂。

sentences.en: And by complete accident, I ended up meeting the two 90-year-old architects
sentences.zh: 阴差阳错之下，我最终遇到了两位90多岁的建筑师，
他们当时正在指导这个项目。

sentences.en: And they had been young architects listening to Gaudí
sentences.zh: 他们当年还是学生时，曾作为年轻的建筑师倾听高迪

sentences.en: explaining his latest discoveries when they were students.
The old architects were ready to move on to the interior of the building,
sentences.zh: 老建筑师们准备着手处理建筑的内部结构，

sentences.en: but they didn't exactly know how to do it.
sentences.zh: 但他们并不确切知道该怎么做。

sentences.en: They knew that he had a system based on geometry.
sentences.zh: 他们知道他有一套基于几何学的系统。

sentences.en: And they knew this system ought to translate into a kind of building methodology.
sentences.zh: 并且他们知道这套系统应该能转化为某种建筑方法论。

sentences.en: In other words, the architects knew it was theoretically possible
sentences.zh: 换句话说，建筑师们知道，从理论上讲，

sentences.en: to figure out how to create the rest of the church.
sentences.zh: 找出如何建造教堂其余部分是完全可能的。

sentences.en: But it was a monumental task.
sentences.zh: 但这却是一项极其庞大的任务。

sentences.en: They pointed Burry to a couple of boxes.
sentences.zh: 他们把伯里带到了几个箱子前。

sentences.en: Boxes full of broken models, plants to Paris models.
sentences.zh: 里面装满了破碎模型的箱子，以及巴黎模型的平面图。

sentences.en: With the invitation to come and join the team
and have a go at untangling the mysteries of the models.
sentences.zh: 尝试解开这些模型背后的奥秘。

sentences.en: For a year, Burry worked with the models,
sentences.zh: 在整整一年的时间里，伯里一直与这些模型打交道，

sentences.en: trying to extrapolate the geometry of the rest of the church
based on the pieces he had.
sentences.zh: 推导出教堂其余部分的几何结构。

sentences.en: After a year, he'd managed to draw out architectural blueprints
sentences.zh: 一年后，他终于成功画出了
其中一扇窗户的建筑蓝图。

sentences.en: Mark Burry didn't stay long at the Sagrada Familia.
sentences.zh: 马克·伯里并没有在圣家堂待太久。

sentences.en: He was only 20, and he had to go back to New Zealand to finish school.
sentences.zh: 他当时只有20岁，必须回新西兰完成学业。

sentences.en: He returned to work on the church 10 years later
and found that when he was gone,
sentences.zh: 发现他不在的那段时间里，

sentences.en: a new thingamabob had been moved into the office.
sentences.zh: 办公室里搬进来一个新奇玩意儿。

sentences.en: So I thought these computers must have something to offer
sentences.zh: 所以我想这些电脑肯定有什么用处，

sentences.en: because I'd never actually personally touched one.
sentences.zh: 因为我以前实际上从来没亲手碰过电脑。

sentences.en: When Burry finally touched the computer,
sentences.zh: 当伯里终于摸到这台电脑时，

sentences.en: he figured out that it had architectural software on it.
sentences.zh: 他发现上面安装了建筑软件。

sentences.en: But the software wasn't capable of dealing with Gaudi.
sentences.zh: 但该软件根本无法处理高迪的设计。

sentences.en: Couldn't even go anywhere near what Gaudi was trying to do.
sentences.zh: 甚至完全无法企及高迪当时试图实现的目标。

sentences.en: The complexity of Gaudi's designs was too much
for architectural software of the early 90s.
sentences.zh: 超出了90年代初建筑软件的极限。

sentences.en: Burry wondered if there was anyone else
sentences.zh: 伯里纳闷是否还有其他人

sentences.en: who designed with similar geometric complexity.
sentences.zh: 会以类似的几何复杂度来进行设计。

sentences.en: And finally, he landed on it.
to figure out an architectural strategy
for the interior of the church.
And because I had this very sophisticated software,
sentences.zh: 而且正因为我拥有这个非常复杂的软件，

sentences.en: by accident I discovered parametric design.
sentences.zh: 我无意中发现了参数化设计。

sentences.en: So we were working parametrically from 1991.
sentences.zh: 所以我们从1991年开始就进行参数化工作了。
参数化设计利用计算机算法，

sentences.en: to allow you to plug in different variables
sentences.zh: 让你能够输入不同的变量，

sentences.en: and see what the end result is each time you change something.
sentences.zh: 并在每次修改某物时看到最终的结果。

sentences.en: Mark Burry was one of the first architects
sentences.zh: 马克·伯里是最早使用计算机

sentences.en: to use computers to design this way,
sentences.zh: 以这种方式进行设计的建筑师之一，

sentences.en: though he eventually figured out that Frank Geary's team
sentences.zh: 尽管他最终发现弗兰克·盖里的团队

sentences.en: had also started using aeronautical software
sentences.zh: 也开始使用航空航天软件

sentences.en: to bring Geary's strangely shaped, curvaceous buildings into being.
sentences.zh: 来打造盖里那些造型奇特、曲线优美的建筑。

sentences.en: Every year, I would go through L.A.
and visit Frank's office and talk to the technical team
sentences.zh: 拜访弗兰克的工作室，和技术团队交流

sentences.en: Eventually, Geary Technologies, with help from Mark Burry,
sentences.zh: 最终，在马克·伯里的帮助下，盖里技术公司

sentences.en: went on to create their own parametric design software,
sentences.zh: 着手开发他们自己的参数化设计软件，

sentences.en: many of the most exciting new projects in architecture
sentences.zh: 建筑界许多最令人兴奋的新项目
都是用这种方式完成的。

sentences.en: At the forefront of this was a church
sentences.zh: 走在这一潮流最前沿的是一座教堂，

sentences.en: by Antony Gaudí, La Sagrada Familia.
sentences.zh: 于一个多世纪前，即圣家堂。

sentences.en: So from being this sort of anachronism
sentences.zh: 因此，从某种不合时宜的
有趣但无关紧要的存在，

sentences.en: it became actually the lead project
sentences.zh: 它实际上成为了整个建筑数字革命中的

sentences.en: in the whole of the digital revolution of architecture.

sentences.zh: 参数化设计让马克·伯里

sentences.en: to move a lot faster on the interior of the church.
sentences.zh: 在教堂内部的设计上进展快得多。

sentences.en: it's possible there would still be no inside to see.
sentences.zh: 可能到现在都还没有可以看到的内部结构。

sentences.en: It was only a few years ago, in 2010,
that the architects were able to put
the finishing touches on the interior.
Now people line up around the block
sentences.zh: 现在人们在街区周围排起长队
而且它确实令人叹为观止，

sentences.en: partly because of these incredibly tall columns
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于高迪设计了这些

sentences.en: that branch out like trees at the top
sentences.zh: 它们在顶部像树枝一样散开，

sentences.en: When people go into that building,
sentences.zh: 当人们走进那座建筑时，

sentences.en: I'm not suggesting that it's necessarily
of walking in through those doors
sentences.zh: 走入这片光芒爆发的震撼与惊奇，
穿过巨大的彩色玻璃窗。

sentences.en: In the afternoon, it's a red-orange light
sentences.zh: 下午时分，呈现红橙色的光芒

sentences.en: and in the morning, it's a bluish-green light.
sentences.zh: 而在早晨，则是蓝绿色的光芒。

sentences.en: And it filters through the huge tree-like columns.
sentences.zh: 光线透过巨大的树状柱子过滤进来。

sentences.en: You feel like you're in a foreSt.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得自己置身于一片森林中。
你会觉得自己非常渺小。
你会觉得自己极其微不足道。

sentences.en: You feel as if there's a whole kind of universe above you.
sentences.zh: 你会感觉仿佛头顶上有整个宇宙。

sentences.en: But the building is still not finished.
I'm in an extremely loud, metal cage elevator
sentences.zh: 我正坐着一个极度吵闹的金属笼式电梯

sentences.en: that runs on the outside of the church

sentences.zh: 和热罗尼莫·布查代罗在一起，

sentences.en: at the very beginning of the story,

sentences.zh: 还有负责圣家堂媒体公关的

sentences.en: who handles press for La Sagrada Familia.
Everything is very safe here, eh?
sentences.zh: 这里一切都很安全，对吧？

sentences.en: but it doesn't feel that safe.
sentences.zh: 但感觉并没有那么安全。

sentences.en: and we can see Barcelona getting smaller below us
sentences.zh: 随着我们沿着教堂的塔楼咯吱咯吱向上升起，

sentences.en: as we rattle up alongside the towers of the church.
sentences.zh: 我们可以看到巴塞罗那在我们脚下变得越来越小。

sentences.en: The elevator door opens to a spectacular view.
sentences.zh: 电梯门打开，展现出壮观的景色。

sentences.en: We are standing on the top
We have the parachutes over there.
sentences.zh: 我们把降落伞放在那边。

sentences.en: Barcelona's city blocks stretch out all around us.
sentences.zh: 巴塞罗那的街区在我们周围延伸开来。

sentences.en: To the east, we can see the Mediterranean Sea,
sentences.zh: 向东望去，我们可以看到地中海，

sentences.en: the mountain that Gaudí promised not to surpass.
sentences.zh: 则是高迪承诺不超越的山峰。

sentences.en: including a new one right where I'm standing.
sentences.zh: 包括我正站着这里的这座新塔楼。

sentences.en: This one will be the tallest of all,
Jerónimo is working on designing it right now,
